## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON, exactly as reported. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; positive Financials, Industrials and Consumer Discretionary returns provide a second confirmation alongside broad sector participation. Leadership: intermediate, with the Top 5 spread across 3 sectors—neither narrow nor broad.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary leads on the week: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND and RCL (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +13.77%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strength: LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) ABOVE TREND; Materials: PPG (1W: +8.06% | 1M: +14.19%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is weakest, down 4.05% for the week and 6.51% for the month; GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) and INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%) are BELOW TREND. Communication is near flat for the week and negative for the month, with TTWO (1W: -6.64% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND; Energy is the next-weakest sector by weekly return, though XOM (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +14.30%) remains ABOVE TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND; LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) ABOVE TREND; RCL (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +13.77%) ABOVE TREND; GILD (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%) ABOVE TREND; PPG (1W: +8.06% | 1M: +14.19%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: intermediate (3/5 sectors; neither narrow nor broad).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: QCOM (1W: -6.32% | 1M: -9.50%) BELOW TREND; PLTR (1W: -6.42% | 1M: -3.12%) BELOW TREND; SHOP (1W: -6.63% | 1M: +5.63%) CORRECTION; TTWO (1W: -6.64% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND; CRM (1W: -7.80% | 1M: -3.18%) BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Technology, with one short-term pullback against a positive monthly trend.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest weekly moves include GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) ABOVE TREND. Divergences: TMUS (1W: +6.76% | 1M: -3.27%) is in RECOVERY, while SHOP (1W: -6.63% | 1M: +5.63%) is in CORRECTION; monitor for confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is weak: sector returns are -4.05% for the week and -6.51% for the month; stock-level positive-count breadth was not supplied. NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -11.36%), GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) and META (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -15.28%) are BELOW TREND, while AAPL (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +4.33%) and MSFT (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +1.78%) are in CORRECTION.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are positive, up 0.96% for the week and 4.15% for the month; stock-level positive-count breadth was not supplied. JPM (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.66%), V (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +14.93%) and MA (1W: +2.31% | 1M: +16.18%) are all ABOVE TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is leading, up 2.26% for the week and 10.22% for the month; stock-level positive-count breadth was not supplied. LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) and GILD (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%) are ABOVE TREND, while UNH (1W: -2.66% | 1M: +11.44%) is in CORRECTION.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Positioning?
Favor participation in the broad advance while remaining selective in Technology; monitor strength in Healthcare, Materials and Consumer Discretionary. Style: mixed / no clear leadership—the strongest performers span three sectors, while Technology is notably weak.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) ABOVE TREND, conditional on continued price strength. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%) and GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%), both BELOW TREND; watch for stabilization.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (+2.26% 1W; +10.22% 1M) and Materials (+2.88% 1W; +9.05% 1M), with positive sector returns; stock-level breadth counts were not supplied. BEARISH: Technology (-4.05% 1W; -6.51% 1M), the only negative sector, and Communication, near flat for the week and down 1.22% for the month.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not included in the data. Monitor whether NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -11.36%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) BELOW TREND stabilize, and whether JPM (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.66%) ABOVE TREND and GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND sustain their positive weekly trends.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
CRH (+75): earnings coverage cited resilient revenue and a $6 billion repurchase plan; CRH (1W: +6.97% | 1M: +11.15%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. GM (+65): repurchase catalyst, while separate privacy-settlement news scored -45; GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND, price strength currently confirms the positive catalyst. LLY (+55): Q3 sales growth; LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
INTC (-40): weak guidance and mixed analyst reactions; INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. META (-35): report questioned its ability to monetize AI; META (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -15.28%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. GM (-45): driver-data privacy settlement; GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND, price action diverges from this negative headline.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, exactly as reported, with 10/11 sectors positive and style mixed / no clear leadership. GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) are showing relative strength, both ABOVE TREND. Monitor Technology weakness and the mixed GM news flow, as broad sector strength has not yet translated into Technology participation.
